en.title: minimalOperations (Adjacent Duplicate Replacements)
en.description: For each word, find the minimum number of character replacements so that no two adjacent characters are the same.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤100); each of the next n lines is a lowercase word of length 2..100000.
en.output: For each word, output one line with the minimum number of replacements.
en.explanation: A linear-scan/dynamic-programming solution follows directly from the rules; the examples have been checked one by one against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a definite array/state transition, then analyze the boundaries.
